title: Ops Pack body
description: Notification routing table (Alerts module) plus an OPTIONAL advisory-only remediation table (AIOps module, issue #52).
$comment: Two independent consumers read this body. (1) Alerts routing: route() reads routes.get(sev, default) with a hard-coded 'ticket' fallback (alerts/module.py:117-123) and load_ops_routing reads routes/default/runbook independently (alerts/module.py:135-158). (2) AIOps advisory remediation (issue #52): reads the additive, OPTIONAL 'remediations' table only. The three groups are independent — a pack may carry routing (default/routes) alone, remediations alone, or both — so the anyOf below admits a remediation-only Ops pack while leaving every routing consumer unaffected. 'remediations' NEVER encodes an executable action: it is advisory human-readable text only (guardrail 5, no auto-remediation).

default.description: Fallback channel when a severity has no explicit route.

routes.description: Map of Severity -> channel (e.g. none | ticket | email | page).

runbook.description: Runbook link surfaced with routed notifications; null/absent is skipped via a truthy check (alerts/module.py:157). 'default' and 'routes' stay strict — a fallback policy must carry a real value.

remediations.description: OPTIONAL, ADVISORY-ONLY (issue #52). Maps a stable, low-cardinality root-cause CATEGORY (the node's classified Discovery role, e.g. 'odb', 'ecp', 'web', 'lb') to an ordered list of advisory remediation steps. The keys '*' and 'default' are documented catch-alls used when no category-specific list matches. The AIOps module attaches these steps to a confidence-gated RCA (advisory only — a human decides and applies; there is NO auto-remediation path). Bounded (max categories, steps, string lengths) to stay fail-closed.

additionalProperties.description: Ordered advisory steps for one root-cause category.

items.$comment: NO field may encode an executable action, script, command, or API call. 'description' is advisory human-readable text; 'runbook' is a citation URL; 'escalateSeverity' is an escalation hint — none is executed.

description.description: Short human-readable advisory action. Advisory text only — never a command, script, or API call.

runbook.description: Optional runbook/citation URL for this step.

escalateSeverity.description: Optional hint: escalate / call support at or above this severity.
